mentions.name: Custom EPYC local AI development workstation
mentions.description: A custom-assembled workstation for general software development and serious local AI work, built around an EPYC 9755 128-core CPU on a Supermicro motherboard with 384GB of RAM and an RTX 6000 Pro Max-Q GPU.
